verses.text: “How you have helped the powerless and saved the arm that is feeble!

xrefs.text: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
Surely you have instructed many, and have strengthened their feeble hands.
At noon Elijah began to taunt them, saying, “Shout louder, for he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or occupied, or on a journey. Perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened!”
I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.
How painful are honest words! But what does your argument prove?

verses.text: How you have counseled the unwise and provided fully sound insight!

xrefs.text: But come back and try again, all of you. For I will not find a wise man among you.
Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?
“Who is this who obscures My counsel by words without knowledge?
Indeed, I waited while you spoke; I listened to your reasoning; as you searched for words,
But if not, then listen to me; be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom.”

verses.text: To whom have you uttered these words? And whose spirit spoke through you?

xrefs.text: So you see, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against you.”
For I am full of words, and my spirit within me compels me.
I have heard a rebuke that insults me, and my understanding prompts a reply.
before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.

verses.text: The dead tremble— those beneath the waters and those who dwell in them.

xrefs.text: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah

The Nephilim were on the earth in those days— and afterward as well — when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of men. And they bore them children who became the mighty men of old, men of renown.
[“]Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?

Speak to him and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, O great monster who lies among his rivers, who says, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it myself.’
Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.

verses.text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

xrefs.text: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD— how much more the hearts of men!
If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
Abaddon and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor about it.’
Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will pull them down.

verses.text: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.

xrefs.text: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.
He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth; its dwellers are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.
He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
This is what God the LORD says— He who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and its offspring, who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it:
From everlasting I was established, from the beginning, before the earth began.

verses.text: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.

xrefs.text: He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters His lightning through them.

Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in His hands? Who has bound up the waters in His cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is the name of His Son— surely you know!
When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and thorns and briers will grow up. I will command the clouds that rain shall not fall on it.”
He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

verses.text: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.

xrefs.text: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven.
But He added, “You cannot see My face, for no one can see Me and live.”
Then Solomon declared: “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.
And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.

verses.text: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.

xrefs.text: when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
Who enclosed the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,

Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.text: The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.

xrefs.text: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor. For the foundations of the earth are the LORD’s, and upon them He has set the world.
Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
“Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am about to shake the heavens and the earth:
At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”

verses.text: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.

xrefs.text: For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
Thus says the LORD, who gives the sun for light by day, who sets in order the moon and stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of Hosts is His name:
God does not restrain His anger; the helpers of Rahab cower beneath Him.
You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
Wisdom and strength belong to God; counsel and understanding are His.

verses.text: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

xrefs.text: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent Leviathan the coiling serpent— and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.

verses.text: Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”

xrefs.text: Lift up your eyes on high: Who created all these? He leads forth the starry host by number; He calls each one by name. Because of His great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
